name: Dryadborn
page: Dryadborn Traits, Dryadborn Gifts, Dryadborn Paragon
provenance: Original A5E player heritage from Gate Pass Gazette #26 as transcribed by the publisher.
sourceDistinctions: The publisher lists one round and no recharge for Protective Petals. Ila’s table uses expiry at the start of her next turn. The Elderbark repeated reroll instruction describes one reroll.

name: Galeoni
page: Galeoni Traits, Galeoni Gifts, Galeoni Paragon
provenance: Original A5E player heritage from Gate Pass Gazette #9 as transcribed by the publisher.
sourceDistinctions: Rending Bite omits the grammatical subject of the Constitution save. The target makes it. Ongoing damage follows Adventurer’s Guide turn-end timing and has no listed damage type. The example applies the damage before the repeat save.

name: Garoul
page: Garoul Traits, Garoul Gifts, Garoul Paragon
provenance: Original A5E player heritage from Gate Pass Gazette #8 as transcribed by the publisher.
sourceDistinctions: The claws entry lists 1d4 slashing without adding an ability modifier. This build preserves that written fixed damage and uses the finesse attack rules.

name: Madrai
page: Madrai Traits, Madrai Gifts, Madrai Paragon

sourceDistinctions: Mycelial in the introduction to Madrai Traits is treated as a copy error. Read proficiency modifier in Boon Companion as proficiency bonus.

name: Oxfolk
page: Home on the Prairie, Oxfolk Traits, Oxfolk Gifts, Oxfolk Paragon
provenance: Original A5E player heritage from Gate Pass Gazette #16 as transcribed by the publisher.
sourceDistinctions: The official article lists height without a size category. Treat Mara as Medium and keep Heavy Lifter’s Large-equivalent limits. The specific paragon entry grants three named benefits in the plural. No paragon affects the level 1 example.
